title: A parametric plate
summary: Drive a plate's thickness from a named parameter, then change the value and watch the plate follow.

steps.title: Add a parameter
steps.text: Open the MODIFY list under the tools and choose Parameters. In the empty row at the bottom type the name thickness and the expression 6 mm, then click Add.

steps.title: Start a sketch
steps.text: Click Create Sketch and choose Top plane (XY).

steps.title: Draw the plate outline
steps.text: Pick the Rectangle tool (R) and click two opposite corners.

steps.title: Extrude by the parameter
steps.text: Click Extrude, click inside the rectangle and type thickness (the parameter's name, not a number) as the distance. Press OK.

steps.title: Change the value
steps.text: In the Parameters window, change the expression of thickness to 12 mm and press Enter. The plate rebuilds twice as thick.

finish: Any feature value or sketch dimension can be an expression of parameters, such as width / 2. Configurations keep several sets of values in one design.
